analysis.gap_orientation: B0 minus reference in percentage points; positive favors B0
analysis.inference_scope: Approximate variation across task clusters within these suites; not uncertainty over training seeds or a guarantee on unseen tasks. The fixed finite panel score itself is directly observed.
reporting: overall and per-suite counts and rates
analysis.resampling: For each suite in manifest order draw an int64 array (20000,10) of task indices from [0,10), with replacement. Retain all 50 paired outcomes for each sampled task; no independent policy or trial resampling. Sum integer success-count differences across the sampled clusters.
analysis.weighting: equal task and suite weights; equivalent to micro average because every task has 50 trials

authorization: User requested clean LIBERO rollouts with the new B0 and comparison with previous OpenVLA and B0 results.

decision.comparison_precision: unrounded computed endpoints; no display rounding or extra tolerance
decision.fail: upper endpoint of paired 95% gap interval < -5.0 percentage points
decision.failure_or_inconclusive_action: Keep Week 4 gate open; diagnose or propose a separately versioned policy/protocol change. Do not silently relax the margin or select a checkpoint on this panel.
decision.gate_is_passed_only_by: PASS with all validity checks satisfied
decision.incomplete: NOT_ASSESSED until the full panel completes
decision.inconclusive: all other valid completed outcomes; including an interval that straddles -5.0
decision.pass: lower endpoint of paired 95% gap interval >= -5.0 percentage points
decision.validity_first: Require all 2000 identified pairs, verified checkpoint/runtime/task/state/seed provenance, valid outcome evidence, and matched initial raw observations; unresolved infrastructure or provenance issues yield NOT_ASSESSABLE.
week4_closure_also_requires: final B0 and protocol evidence freeze

interpretation: Previously inspected development panel. Existing B0/OpenVLA outcomes influenced the new architecture; this is not an unseen holdout, an architecture-causal comparison, or training-matched reproduction. Original margin, statistical method, protocol, states and seeds are unchanged.

b0.selection: Update 72000 selected by full validation objective and reload-verified before new rollout outcomes; fixed for this entire panel.

prior_b0_comparison: Descriptive paired improvement with the same interval; acceptance threshold applies only against the pinned OpenVLA reference.

reuse.method: Verify sealed original final report, identities, all 4000 receipt digests and artifact/attempt SHA-256 bytes; retain original identities and recordings in place. Check every new pair against both cached policies.
